title: German-Style Sausage and Grain Bowl
description: A hearty, comforting bowl filled with spicy sausage, crunchy grains, and a tangy slaw. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Jagged German Sausages
ingredients.notes: look for smoked or knockwurst sausages

instructions: Cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Slice the onions and toss with vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the sausages until browned and cooked through.
Serve the sausages on top of a bed of grains, with roasted onions and a dollop of flan.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with additional sliced onions and a sprinkle of grains, if desired.
